subject: Action required — collections action & tax evidence for BorealTech INV-2026-11
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@borealtech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@borealtech.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-11 / VAT documentation

Hi Michael,

Hope you’re well. Our AP team has flagged invoice INV-2026-11 (attached) as past due — the invoice was issued on Oct 28 and shows Redwood VAT details in the EU column. We’re currently withholding payment pending confirmation of the correct VAT treatment (reverse-charge vs. vendor VAT).

Can you confirm Redwood's VAT registration number for this invoice or provide the supplier documentation your AP needs to process a reverse-charge? Our deadline to clear aged payables is next week, so a quick turnaround would be appreciated.

Attachment: [BorealTech_INV-2026-11.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Finance Operations
BorealTech
elena.ruiz@borealtech.com
+44 20 7946 07XX
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@borealtech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@borealtech.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-11 / VAT documentation

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. I understand the hold. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- Redwood is not collecting local VAT on that invoice; the invoice should be treated under reverse-charge for EU B2B transactions.
- I'm attaching our standard tax evidence checklist which lists the documents AP teams typically accept (VAT number match, purchase order, business registration).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you share the specific field AP says is missing (VAT number / company name mismatch)?
2) If AP needs a supplier VAT certificate, I can send a signed supplier declaration by EOD tomorrow.
3) If payment cannot be processed within 5 business days due to local compliance checks, please confirm so we can coordinate next steps (partial payment, credit hold).

Attachment: [redwood_tax_evidence_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

I'll keep Marissa and our collections lead Sean in the loop. If AP needs anything formal for re-issuance, let me know.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@borealtech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@borealtech.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@borealtech.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-11 / VAT documentation

Michael / Elena —

Apologies for the slow follow-up. AP is holding payment because their tax team requires either: (a) a confirmed Redwood VAT registration number to match our entity; or (b) a supplier declaration confirming Redwood is not VAT-registered in our jurisdiction and that reverse-charge applies. Our internal policy will not allow us to post the invoice without one of the two options.

We expect the VAT review to be closed by next Wednesday at the earliest. If you can provide the supplier declaration (signed) or confirm the VAT ID, we will prioritize settlement.

FYI, our AR team is open to a partial remittance (50%) if the final documentation follows within 7 days.

Carlos Mendes
AP Specialist
BorealTech
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation request — BorealTech payment hold on INV-2026-11 (VAT dispute)

Team,

Looping you in — BorealTech (DE region) has placed INV-2026-11 on hold pending VAT evidence. Their AP has offered a potential 50% partial remittance if we can deliver the supplier declaration quickly, but they are otherwise holding funds pending tax sign-off. 

Key facts:
- Invoice: INV-2026-11; amount: EUR 148,500; due: 2026-11-27 (now past due).
- External: BorealTech AP (Carlos/Elena) — hold due to VAT reverse-charge confirmation.
- Our position: invoice should be reverse-charge; supply supplier declaration + checklist.

Requested approvals / actions:
1) Approve sending a signed supplier declaration and quick confirmation of Redwood VAT details (I've drafted the statement and attached checklist).
2) If BorealTech does not remit full or partial payment by 7 calendar days after we send documentation, approve next steps: a 10% late fee and temporary service restriction until payment agreement is in place. Legal to confirm contract language on service suspension.
3) Sales / CSM (Marissa) to offer a short-term mitigation (credit hold removal if partial payment received).

Attachment: [redwood_tax_evidence_checklist.xlsx] (draft supplier declaration ready).

I recommend we prioritize a signed declaration today so BorealTech can move their AP process forward. Please reply with approvals or alternate instructions.

Thanks,
Michael
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation request — BorealTech payment hold on INV-2026-11 (VAT dispute)

Michael / team —

Approved: proceed to send the supplier declaration and the checklist immediately. If BorealTech does not provide either a full or the 50% partial payment within 7 calendar days of our submission, proceed with the 10% late fee and temporary suspension of non-critical services. Legal: please confirm the suspension clause under SOW/Order Form and prepare a short notice template.

Also: loop Sales into any negotiation of payment plan or credit exceptions. Marissa, please prepare a one-page mitigation (payment plan options + proposed timeline) we can offer if AP needs more time.

Keep this tight — our DSO is already above target this quarter and we should not set a precedent for delayed payment without documented remedies.

Naomi Feldman
VP Finance (Acting CFO)
Redwood Inference
